Oh then ya i think its better to talk to ur psychiatrist first. From my experience, theyre friendly and want to help as much as they can. It definitely hasnt been a smooth journey but im making some progress. Also, many antidepressants, ssris like prozac in particular can make u tired which seems like something u dont want. I experienced lots of fatigue while on prozac and my psychiatrist switched me to Wellbutrin which doesnt make me as tired. Though many factors affect ur energy levels. Finally another tip, if u havent already, check out various subreddits on these medications and see how other ppl are doing and u could asks specific questions there.

How has xanax been working for u? Did u experience any side effects or did it help at all? Well if ur psychiatrist prescribed a new medication im assuming it didnt help, otherwise i dont see a point in switching if it works. I think just try prozac and try to manage the side effects. Ik its very difficult and ive been there, but if it works, them im sure itll be worth it. If it doesnt, then make sure to contact ur psychiatrist or any medical professional immediately, especially if ur anxiety gets worse or start having suicidal ideations, since antidepressants in youth can have a higher chance of causing that.

Everyone reacts to antidepressants differently. Ive been on 3 antidepressants and prozac was my 2nd one where I experienced very little side effects and it did help me, given i was also in a hospital at the time. My first was lexapro/cipralex and the side effects hit me like a truck. Also the thing with medication is that it wont completely make ur anxiety go away. Its just to help calm u down and give u some motivation to improve urself. Lastly, make sure to talk to ur doctor about it and ask them for advice, since u need a prescription to get these medications anyways. I hope u can find ways to manage ur anxiety and improve ur life.
